services.title: See what {clinic} offers
services.body: Every service {clinic} is currently booking, with the price the clinic charges for it.

book.title: Book a consultation
book.body: Choose a service, a clinician, a time and how you would like to be seen — in person, by video, by voice or by chat.

appointments.title: Your appointments
appointments.body: What you have booked, what you have already attended, and the link to join a consultation when it is time.

prescriptions.title: Your prescriptions
prescriptions.body: What has been prescribed for you, and the written prescription itself.

hub.byLinkHeading: Opened from a link {clinic} sends you
hub.byLinkBody: Paying for a dispensed order, choosing collection or delivery, and tracking a delivery all open from a link {clinic} sends you. There is no list of them here, because the clinic's system does not yet offer this portal one — so please keep the message {clinic} sent.
hub.contact: To change an appointment or ask about your care, contact {clinic} directly. Carevelo provides the software and cannot answer a clinical question.
hub.contactWithPhone: To change an appointment or ask about your care, contact {clinic} directly on {phone}. Carevelo provides the software and cannot answer a clinical question.

booking.noRecordTitle: We cannot tell which patient record is yours
booking.noRecordBody: Booking has to be attached to a patient record, and {clinic}'s system does not yet let this portal ask which record belongs to your sign-in. Please telephone {clinic} and they will book for you at the desk.
booking.noRecordBodyWithPhone: Booking has to be attached to a patient record, and {clinic}'s system does not yet let this portal ask which record belongs to your sign-in. Please telephone {clinic} on {phone} and they will book for you at the desk.

fulfilment.consentNotHere: Having medicines brought to you means giving {clinic} your address to pass to a rider, and that permission has to be recorded by {clinic} rather than on this page. Please telephone the clinic, or choose collection.
